rationale: Evaluating omission of required braking requires characterising braking execution itself. SG-1 and FR-7 establish this system response as the subject of evaluation, while H-1 supports the obstacle and road-user context. The declared scope uses obstacle-detection/braking scenarios as context without incorporating detection, computation, communication, or internal control mechanisms into P, and adds no unsupported temporal behaviour.
determining_elements: “Braking-maneuver execution state” directly identifies the behaviour whose omission T seeks to prevent.
The scope restricts consideration to driving situations where braking may be required to avoid collision with obstacles or road users.
Including the hazardous operational situation and related requirement scenarios is supported by H-1 and FR-7; it does not make the mechanisms used to detect obstacles part of the phenomenon.
